sloka: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः ।मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ ।। ५.३९.३८।।।।
transliteration: madviśiṣṭāśca tulyāśca santi tatra vanaukasaḥ ।mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścinnāsti sugrīvasannidhau ।। 5.39.38।।।।

translations.english: "The vanaras under Sugriva who move in the forest are more powerful than me or equal to me. None is inferior to me.
